title: Councillors and municipal officers and employees to be public servants
text:
500. Councillors and municipal officers and employees to be public servants.—[Every Councillor

and every person referred to in clause (b) of sub-section (3) of section 3, the Commissioner,] and every
municipal officer and other municipal employee shall be deemed to be a public servant within the meaning
of section 21 of the Indian Penal Code (45 of 1860), and in the definition of “legal remuneration” in section
161 of that Code the word “Government” shall, for the purpose of this section, be deemed to include [[the
Corporation]].
